sn36.21:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn36.21:1.2: atha kho moḷiyasivako paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn36.21:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho moḷiyasivako paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn36.21:1.4: santi bho gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
sn36.21:1.5: yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbekatahetūti.
sn36.21:2.1: pittasamuṭṭhānānipi kho sivaka idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:2.2: sāmaṃpi kho etaṃ sivaka evaṃ veditabbaṃ yathā pittasamuṭṭhānānipi idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:2.3: lokassapi kho etaṃ sivaka saccasammataṃ yathā pittasamuṭṭhānānipi idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:2.4: tatra sivaka ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
sn36.21:2.5: yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedayati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbekatahetūti.
sn36.21:2.6: yañca sāmaṃ ñātaṃ tañca atidhāvanti yaṃ loke saccasammataṃ tañca atidhāvanti.
sn36.21:3.7: kammavipākajānipi kho sivaka idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:3.8: sāmaṃpi kho etaṃ sivaka evaṃ veditabbaṃ
sn36.21:3.12: tattha sivaka ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
sn36.21:3.13: yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedayati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbekatahetūti.
sn36.21:3.14: yañca sāmaṃ ñātaṃ tañca atidhāvanti yaṃ loke saccasammataṃ tañca atidhāvanti
sn36.21:4.1: evaṃ vutte moḷiyasivako paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn36.21:4.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
sn36.21:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
